_comment: Cross-subsidiary scenario, exercised through both layers by different routes. BE: the same credentials posted with 1_country set to another subsidiary. FE: the browser cannot override that field, so the equivalent — and the only route a real user has — is to drive that country's locale login page with this subsidiary's credentials (fe.config_for_country). expected.error_message stays null because any error text would render in the other locale's language. See PLAN.md section 5.
name: S1_mismatched_country
description: Valid KOR credentials submitted with country='usa'. A success here would be a cross-subsidiary credential leak.

expected._comment: Only what the BE cannot tell us. Identity and session shape come from LoginResult. error_message is the locale-specific text the FE renders; null means assert only that the login was rejected.
